DIFF_ATTACK_SURFACES: Contract and serialization attack: declaration-only case labels, incomplete response tuples, repeated request IDs, permissive manifests, or generic nonzero exits could counterfeit a passing report.

State and resource attack: non-cooperative JavaScript could survive cancellation, exceed RSS between polls, leak cached heap state, avoid recycling/quarantine, or leave an unreaped process or reader thread.
Integration attack: formatter text or the first unrelated IIFE could nominate the wrong function, while a changed extractor version could still reuse a stale prepared-program cache entry.
Gate attack: a report could claim counterfactual rejection without calling the same aggregate acceptance oracle, or pass path/protocol probes on an always-failing worker.
INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN: Correctness/proof-integrity reviewer Hypatia independently inspected the diff, corpus oracle, AST discovery, cache evidence, report fields, manifest validation, response correlation, and cancellation path.

Security/resource-isolation reviewer Kant independently forged producer/grant tuples, invoked destructive modes, inspected protocol exits, process cleanup, cancellation, quarantine, and error-path ownership.

The primary reran the release corpus after every remediation and directly inspected all seven case rows, all twenty probe rows, counterfactual fields, typed fatal diagnostics, and process-absence receipts.
The complete workspace all-target/all-feature tests, doctests, formatting, check, warnings-denied Clippy, and FF-GATE-ARCH-001 passed after hardening.
COUNTERFACTUAL_CHECKS: The corpus clones the actual case evidence, mutates one required expected value, recalculates its match state, and proves the same behavioral_acceptance function rejects the complete mutated evidence set.
A harmless prelude IIFE containing alr, yes, and an unrelated function no longer wins discovery over the later real challenge-shaped assignment.
Unrelated marker literals plus a function without those markers in its own subtree produce NoChallengeCandidate instead of a false candidate.
Forged response producer, request, job, sequence, compatibility, provenance, or grant fields are rejected by full_response_correlation_rejects_forged_tuple_fields.
A forged destructive-probe grant returns typed InvalidInput and the same worker remains reusable for a subsequent authorized capability request.
BOUNDARY_PROBES: Spawned-worker cache proof observes initial miss, identical-key hit, and changed-extractor-version miss through the real framed process boundary.
Every response is correlated across schema/version, request, job, producer, strict sequence, compatibility range, provenance, and capability grant; request IDs include a worker-PID restart namespace.
Cancellation crosses the public framed control boundary and must return the same correlated generation before the parent accepts AcknowledgedCancelled and verifies process absence.
Path traversal crosses the raw framed protocol boundary and must emit the exact protocol_reference fatal category before exit and reap.
Quarantine is keyed by provenance: two terminal failures block that key without spawning another worker, an independent key remains admitted, and explicit operator clear restores admission.
NEGATIVE_PATH_CHECKS: Zero, oversized, partial-header, partial-payload, malformed-JSON, incompatible-version, unknown-field, over-memory, and traversal frames require exact fatal categories, non-success exit, reap, and process absence.
Infinite loop, cancellation, allocation bomb, deliberate crash, and worker-quota exhaustion each require their distinct terminal observation rather than any generic worker exit.
Hash mismatch and unauthorized destructive probes return typed InvalidInput responses; they cannot be counted as successful challenge results.
Manifest validation rejects executable/non-mandatory oracle policy, malformed source commit/player/hash/version identities, empty or oversized deterministic inputs, and mismatched player filenames.
Architecture and Cargo policy reject forbidden external runtimes, native links, build-time downloads, prebuilt binaries, indirect yt-dlp wrappers, and companion solver assets.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: The original counterfactual checked a declaration-level mismatch rather than executing the same aggregate acceptance oracle over mutated real evidence.
The initial parent termination path labeled cancellation without receiving a correlated worker acknowledgement or distinguishing forced termination.
Initial discovery selected the first IIFE and parsed formatter text, allowing decoy marker text or a harmless prelude to nominate the wrong function.
The first cache probe did not change extractor_version through a spawned worker, so it did not prove the complete behavior-affecting key.
Case reports omitted deterministic inputs and manifest provenance validation was too weak for an independently inspectable behavioral receipt.
Response validation did not bind the complete envelope tuple and request IDs could repeat after worker restart.
Destructive crash and resource probe modes trusted forgeable wire declarations instead of a fresh host-issued per-worker capability grant.
Raw protocol probes accepted any nonzero worker exit and therefore could falsely pass against an always-failing binary.
The initial supervisor had no provenance-keyed failure threshold, independent-key isolation, or explicit operator-clear recovery path.
Supervisor error paths lacked an idempotent RAII cleanup owner for stdin closure, termination, reap, and reader-thread joining.

RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: Compatibility evidence covers three committed raw player generations and seven mandatory observations; it does not prove full YouTube support, live-site stability, extractor behavior, download behavior, or replacement parity.
Boa exposes no exact heap cap; parent RSS polling and process termination can observe transient allocation overshoot before enforcement.
Canonicalization confines the opened corpus path under the player root, but hostile local junction or symlink replacement races are not proven absent across all platforms.
The capability probe checks named ambient globals and no host functions are registered, but this spike does not constitute a complete security audit of every Boa intrinsic.

Boa 0.21.1 transitively requires archived paste 1.0.15 with no safe upgrade under RUSTSEC-2024-0436; the reasoned cargo-deny exception is bounded to this prerequisite and must be removed or explicitly re-authorized before a later product consumer.
This proof ran on Windows; cross-platform supervisor, RSS, process-tree, and path behavior remains to be re-proven by any later shipped consumer.

risk_scenarios.risk: A candidate pulls an unapproved native/runtime/build dependency transitively.
risk_scenarios.failure_scenario: Cargo features, build scripts, downloads, prebuilt binaries, FFI, or Cargo links violate the Rust-only boundary.
risk_scenarios.mitigation_and_hardening: Inspect source/build scripts/features/transitive graph and artifacts, disable defaults, pin lockfile, and fail architecture policy on undeclared runtime/native mechanisms.
risk_scenarios.verification_needed: Cargo metadata, lockfile, source/build scan, clean-artifact smoke, and linkage/provenance inspection show only approved boundaries.

risk_scenarios.risk: Performance is reported from unequal or warm-only work.
risk_scenarios.failure_scenario: A cached persistent worker appears fast while startup, isolation, cache miss, or failure costs are hidden.
risk_scenarios.mitigation_and_hardening: Report cold/warm/recycle/cache-hit/cache-miss topologies separately after correctness and resource gates; use distributions, not a single timing.
risk_scenarios.verification_needed: Versioned manifest records exact topology, case set, cache state, sample distribution, failures, and no speed verdict before correctness.
